blurb: Established in 1894, Cohasset Golf Club is one of the oldest private clubs in New England. Members enjoy a challenging 18-hole Donald Ross course, practice on a conveniently located driving range or short game area, play on one of four lighted clay tennis courts or our three paddle tennis courts and pickleball courts with warming hut.
